description:
QBDS wrapper for Icon — size, tone, and opacity.

Static icons: variant (primary/secondary).
Icon-only buttons: hoverable (variant not accepted).
disabled overrides opacity in either mode.

size.description: sm (16px), default (24px), lg (32px). Provides size context to Icon.

type.description: Colour tone. Use type="custom" + className for brand/status colours.

disabled.description: Disabled opacity (30%). Works in static and hoverable modes.

hoverable.description: Icon-only button: secondary rest, primary on hover/active. Do not pass variant.

variant.description: Static opacity: primary (88%) or secondary (60%). Not used with hoverable.
